description: Source code for the PublicSourceDirProvider class, a ContentProvider that facilitates sharing APK files by providing URIs and handling file access, specifically for sharing installed app APKs within the F-Droid project.

classes.name: PublicSourceDirProvider
classes.description: A ContentProvider subclass that provides URIs and file access to APKs of installed applications for sharing purposes.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the ContentProvider, returns true indicating successful creation.

methods.name: getUri
methods.description: Constructs a content URI for sharing the APK of a specified package.

methods.name: getApkShareIntent
methods.description: Creates an Intent to share the APK URI with appropriate MIME type and permissions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Returns metadata about the APK file, including display name, MIME type, data URI, and size.

methods.name: getType
methods.description: Returns the MIME type for APK sharing.

methods.name: openFile
methods.description: Provides read-only ParcelFileDescriptor for the APK file.

methods.name: getApplicationInfo
methods.description: Retrieves ApplicationInfo for the APK based on URI, extracting package name from URI.
